# lamejs 1.2.1 (MP3 encoder)

`1.2.1/lame.min.js` is the unmodified browser build of [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) 1.2.1 (npm `lamejs`),
a JavaScript port of [LAME](https://lame.sourceforge.io/), licensed under the LGPL-3.0. Universe links it as a separate
file: only the Admin Hub's stand-up set maker loads it, to turn Ant-Thony's voiced set into one MP3 for the Colony Stage.
